The '''Chief of State's Briefing Office''' was a room on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] used by the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. It may have been within the [[Chief of State's Suite]].
